source.identity_limit: UI/sequence whole-file blob pins fetched at d158; UI SHA256 reused from exact same3c41 blob receipt. Not package/runtime execution.

indices: Internal bar/pattern indices are0-based; LCD BAR/P labels are1-based.

cursor.empty: len0 has only cursor0. K5+ clamps0;it does not append.
cursor.one_bar: After adding bar0,len1,cursor1 is END/displayBAR2. K5− returns0;K5+ returns1.
cursor.advance: White pad/key write advances only if k+1<192. Writing existing bar191 or appending last bar191 leaves cursor191.
cursor.page_navigation: K2/ordinary arrows move between two BAR pages with clamp0..1,not wrap. K5 edits bar value,not page.
cursor.dirty: Generic pref_set marks dirty before R_SBAR assignment,even a clamped attempt. Cursor edit does not itself create a bar or change pattern arrays.

fill_defaults.first: song_fill first bar copies each seq.ppat[p];mute byte0 means all parts unmuted/repeat1.
fill_defaults.later: New bars copy the whole preceding bar,including all part pattern IDs,mutes and repeat bits.
fill_defaults.trigger: White pad assignment,black mute,per-part scalar,repeat scalar or length extension can call song_fill. Merely selecting END does not.

pad_and_key_input.gate: SONG,no PATCH held,no earlier BT-copy modifier,keydown only,k<192;key-up never writes.
pad_and_key_input.white: wp=patternBank*16+whiteIndex. Fill selected bar,set all five bar.pat[p]=wp,advance cursor as above,mark dirty. This edits the Song;it does not merely queue live patterns.
pad_and_key_input.black: Only first5 logical black keys accepted. Fill selected bar,XOR1<<part_at(blackIndex),keep cursor. Order909,808,BREAK,BASS B,BASS A. Others ignored.
pad_and_key_input.mods: BT+white has earlier pattern-copy/paste priority. PATCH+white uses Home cue/chain route. Do not treat either as unmodified Song bar entry.

scalar_semantics.patterns: R_SPAT clamp0..31,displayP1..P32. At END read previous bar's per-part assignment,or current seq.ppat when empty. Edit fills the row and changes only that part;cursor stays.
scalar_semantics.repeat: R_SREP clamp0..7,displayx1..x8. At END its read value is0(x1),even if preceding bar repeats more. Edit fills then writes high3 mute bits,retaining low5 part-mute bits;cursor stays.
scalar_semantics.pinned_smc: r.b can bind explicit bar. Deleted bound bar is not recreated. Ordinary panel r.b0 follows ui.song_sel.
scalar_semantics.length: List LENGTH0..192. Extending inherits through song_fill;shortening updates len and clamps cursor to len,or191 when full. Stored beyond-length bytes are not represented as active bars.

body.view: 11 visible bar slots under heading,with selected-row highlight and current playing-bar triangle only when song_on&&playing.
body.end: k==len is END;empty row0 says EMPTY: WHITE KEYS ADD BARS. It displays no stored part pattern IDs.
body.rows: Existing row shows each part Pn;muted part prints '-';x2..x8 shown only when repeat>1. Selected cursor is separate from sounding song_pos.

transport_record.enter: Ordinary PATCH toggles HOME→SONG;from other no-overlay view goes HOME first. Questions/list/pending-sound routes can consume PATCH first.
transport_record.play: While stopped input sets song_on=(view==V_SONG). PLAY start uses selected bar if selected<len,else0. While playing,navigation does not change song_on. PLAY stops separately.
transport_record.rec: SEQ REC toggles broad ui.rec on press;seq.song_rec=seq.song_on&&ui.rec. Manual bar editing works independently of REC. Starting SONG+REC writes arrangement at selected existing bar or0 if END.
transport_record.recorded_bar: Source song_write stores current next[] pattern tuple plus current part mutes,grows len,and resets repeat bits to1 by starting mute byte0. Recording is arrangement state,not audio/allFX.
transport_record.capacity: At192 new recorded bars source clears song_rec;does not allocate beyond capacity. UI REC lamp still represents ui.rec,not proof that arrangement storage continues.

feedback.buttons: PATCH lit in HOME/SONG;PLAY follows source beat/WAIT;REC lit when ui.rec;BT uses source saved/dirty/queued/failure policy.
feedback.pads: When LIGHTS enabled,used patterns dim. Existing selected bar's909 pattern bright in visible bank. Empty/END has no selected existing bar,so no current-pattern bright layer is added. HOME queued-cue blink is not applied as SONG pending cue.
feedback.logical_black: Source mute k/d masks for black keys are not proof of physical keybedLEDs;SMK hardware has no piano-key LEDs.

minimal_reducer_dispositions: Do not repair empty Song K5 clamp by inventing an append. Repair unmodified pad write+len+cursor advance first.
After pad0 into empty:len1,cursor1,bar0 all fiveP1,repeat1,unmuted. Cursor now END,not selected storedbar0.
K5− then+ must visit storedbar1 and ENDbar2 without changing assignments;retain source dirty-policy distinction.
Both BAR pages edit the exact selected row/part/repeat;K2 page clamping is independent.
Do not select CP2/CP3 to implement current manual Song authoring or current view-owned start behavior.
limits: No CP2 choice,CP3 freeze,CP1/Settings redesign or new owner.
